description: This file defines the PodExpansion interface and its methods for managing Kubernetes pods, including binding, eviction, log retrieval, and proxy access.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Applies a binding to a specified pod in the current namespace.

methods.name: Evict
methods.description: Submits an eviction request to the pod's eviction subresource (deprecated).

methods.name: EvictV1beta1
methods.description: Submits a v1beta1 eviction request to the pod's eviction subresource.

methods.name: EvictV1
methods.description: Submits a v1 eviction request to the pod's eviction subresource.

methods.name: GetLogs
methods.description: Constructs a request to get logs for a specific pod.

methods.name: ProxyGet
methods.description: Returns a response of the pod by calling it through the proxy.
